scenario.title: Northstar shared-workspace pilot
scenario.decisionQuestion: Should Northstar run a six-week pilot for a shared-workspace booking service?
constraints: Do not make a launch decision without conversion evidence.

sources.title: Synthetic market interview summary
sources.content: Twelve synthetic interview summaries indicate interest in flexible booking, while pricing sensitivity remains high. Interview notes recommend measuring repeat booking before expansion.

sources.title: Synthetic pilot cost note
sources.content: The synthetic pilot budget allocates 18,000 EUR to venue partnerships, 12,000 EUR to outreach, and 10,000 EUR to contingency. A decision requires a documented conversion threshold.

sources.title: Synthetic risk register extract
sources.content: Synthetic risks include uncertain demand, partner availability, and incomplete pricing evidence. The recommended mitigation is a bounded pilot with explicit stop criteria.
